translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content: B'it yic ac'oj yuj diosal d'a Jehová
Sb'itaj jun b'it tic ayic tz'och yopisio jun templo. Sb'it jun tic vin̈aj David.

content.text: Mamin Jehová, tzach in b'itej yed' in vach' lolonel, yujto ix in a sic'q'ue vaan d'a scal in nivan yaelal, maj in a cha b'uchjoc yuj eb' ayoch ajc'olal d'ayin.
Mamin, in Diosal ach, ix in c'an a colval, ix ac'an b'oxoc in c'ool.
Mamin, a ach ton ix in a colel d'a chamel. Ix ac' in q'uinal, maj in a chab'atlaj d'a scal eb' chamnac.
B'itanan̈ec d'a Jehová, mach ex to schon̈ab' ex, b'itejec yujto an̈ej Te Nivan Yelc'ochi.
Yujto junn̈ej rato ay yoval sc'ool, axo svach'c'olal ayn̈ejec' d'a masanil tiempo. Vach'chom tzon̈ oc' d'ac'valil, axo yic sq'uin̈ib'i sja co tzalajc'olal.
Ayic te vach' vaji, ix in na' icha tic: Malaj b'aq'uin̈ ol in telvoc yuj junoc tas, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, yuj val svach'il a c'ool, ix in ac'canoch b'aj malaj tas tzin ic'ani. Palta ayic ix ic'anel a b'a d'ayin, ix somchajcanel in c'ool.
Mamin, ix ach vavtej, ix valan in b'a d'ayach:

¿Tasto a ganar d'ayin, q'uinaloc tato tzin chami, tzin mucchaji? Man̈xo ol yal-laj ach sb'itan eb' toxo ix och pococal. Man̈ ol yal pax laj yalan vach' lolonel eb' d'ayach yuj svach'il tas ix a b'o'o, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, ab' val tas svala', oc'oc val a c'ool d'ayin. Mamin, ochan̈n̈ej ved'oc.
Ix ac'an q'uexmaj in yaelal d'a tzalajc'olal. Ix ic'anel in cusc'olal, ix ac'ancanoch c'apac pichul yic q'uin̈ in pichuloc.
Yuj val chi' jun, ach Jehová in Diosal, max yal-laj vem numan. Tzin b'itan d'ayach d'a aloj vach' lolonel yed' ac'oj yuj diosal d'ayach d'a masanil tiempo.
